summary: Completed frontend testing of Gestionnaire (Client Manager) portal. All features working correctly: login flow, dashboard navigation, all 3 tabs (SÉANCES, ÉLÈVES, FORMATEURS), and logout functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: GestionnaireDashboard.js correctly uses props (user, onLogout) passed from App.js
useEffect dependencies are properly configured to avoid infinite loops
All 3 tabs have proper styling with distinct background colors (green for SÉANCES, violet for ÉLÈVES, amber for FORMATEURS)
Empty states are properly handled with appropriate messages
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test gestionnaire account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gestionnaire portal is fully functional. Test account is linked to 'Centre Test TerciForm' client. Expected data: 0 students, 0 sessions, 1 formateur (Jonathan GHIZZO). The 'Maximum update depth exceeded' bug has been fixed.

login_flow.details: Login with gestionnaire-test@terciform.com / TestGestionnaire2026! works correctly

dashboard_loads.details: Dashboard loads without infinite loop, shows 'Espace Gestionnaire' header and 'Centre Test TerciForm' client name

seances_tab.details: Monthly planning calendar displays correctly with month/year selectors, shows '0 séance(s) en Janvier 2026'

eleves_tab.details: Students tab displays 'Élèves de votre centre (0)' with empty state message 'Aucun élève associé à votre centre'

formateurs_tab.details: Formateurs tab displays 'Formateurs (1)' with Jonathan GHIZZO card showing email (terciform@gmail.com) and subjects (Anglais, Bureautique, Informatique)

logout_functionality.details: Logout button works correctly, redirects to login page

ui_observations.header: Dark slate gradient header with TerciForm logo, 'Espace Gestionnaire' title, client name, user name, and logout button
ui_observations.tabs: Three colorful tabs with icons - SÉANCES (green), ÉLÈVES (violet), FORMATEURS (amber)
ui_observations.background_colors: Background color changes based on active tab (emerald for sessions, violet for students, amber for formateurs)
ui_observations.formateur_card: Orange gradient header with photo, name, company, email, and subject tags
